items.title: vi) Kinetic energy based on KMT (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: vi) Kinetic energy based on KMT: a main subheading of 5.11 General properties of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Kinetic energy particles ki harkat se aati hai. Solid ke particles sirf vibrate karte hain; na translational harkat karte hain na rotational. Is liye solid ke paas sirf vibrational kinetic energy hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Gas, liquid aur solid ka comparison
rows: Sab se kam (gol particles zyada se zyada 74% jagah bharte hain)

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Quick Check 5.8 ke sawal (compression, expansion, translatory motion, habit) kitab topic 5.12.2 ke baad chhapti hai; un ke jawab wahin hain.

items: Solids: compression nahi (close packing, gol particles zyada se zyada 74% jagah), expansion na hone ke barabar, sirf vibration (na translatory na rotational), particles ke darmiyan sab se kam jagah, ionic/covalent/metallic/van der Waals forces, sirf vibrational kinetic energy.
